stories.headline: The Nasdaq Just Did Something For Just the 5th Time Ever. History Says This Could Happen Next.
stories.body: AI stocks have had a wild ride over the last month. First, they fell over concerns about a tightening credit environment, and then, following the midterm elections, fears of a crackdown on data centers sent the Invesco QQQ Trust (NASDAQ:QQQ) down 6.5% on Nov. 5.

stories.headline: IT software vendor banks use hit with third security threat
stories.body: N-able took its hosted N-central software offline Monday after a researcher published exploit code. Providers running their own servers still have to install the fix.

stories.headline: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
stories.body: The consumer price index rose more than expected in October, raising alarm among Federal Reserve officials.
